Folkestone hotel fire treated as suspicious; dozens evacuated

A major fire at the Grand Burstin Hotel in Folkestone is being treated as suspicious by police. Dozens of people living in homes adjacent to the hotel were moved due to safety concerns following the blaze. One report indicated the hotel may have been deliberately set on fire.
